Tidewell (YC S24) | London, UK | Software Engineer, ML Engineer | ONSITE (Hybrid ok) | Full-time + INTERNS | https://www.linkedin.com/company/tidewell

Tidewell forecasts tidal and offshore wind output for grid operators. We're 14 people in Shoreditch, profitable, and our models run every 15 minutes for National Grid ESO and three European TSOs.

We're hiring two engineers and, for summer 2027, two INTERNS (penultimate-year or master's students; we pay £3,200/month and sponsor Student visas where we can).

Stack: Python, Rust, Postgres, a bit of TypeScript.

All roles: https://jobs.lever.co/tidewell

More about us: https://www.tidewell.co.uk/ and https://www.tidewell.co.uk/careers/internships

Email hiring [at] tidewell.co.uk with "HN" in the subject, or me directly: ana.kowalski@tidewell.co.uk
